title: Senior Sales Consultant / Closer  (m/w/d)
description:

title: Senior Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Schwerpunkt Performance Marketing
description:
Über uns Bei uns musst Du Dich nicht zwischen Kreativität und harten Zahlen entscheiden - wir brauchen beides. Und jemanden, der sein Wissen gerne weitergibt.
Als Senior Marketing Manager (m/w/d) entwickelst Du Themen, Kampagnen und Formate von der ersten Idee bis zur Auswertung: Lead-Magnete und Funnel, Webinar-Reihen und Fachveranstaltungen, Kampagnen über SEA, LinkedIn und Newsletter, die aktiv ineinandergreifen statt nebeneinanderher zu laufen. Was Du dabei nie aus dem Blick verlierst: die Zahlen dahinter. Du sorgst dafür, dass am Ende messbar ist, was davon wirkt und was nicht - und leitest entsprechende Maßnahmen ab. Dein Ziel: avenit als starke Marke zu positionieren und sicherzustellen, dass unser Vertrieb verlässlich mit qualifizierten Leads versorgt wird. Den Weg dorthin gestaltest Du selbst. Zusätzlich begleitest Du unser Digital Marketing Team bei Kundenprojekten als fachlicher Sparringspartner, indem Du Dein Know-how und Erfahrungen teilst und dem Team so hilfst, sich weiterzuentwickeln.

title: Staff/Senior Software Engineer - Hydris - Golang (d/f/m)
description:
New Challenge About Us
Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a Germany-based DefenseTech company with offices in Berlin and Munich. We network market-available sensors, effectors, or situational awareness systems into a tactical IoT backbone that reliably provides armed forces and security agencies with cross-domain information superiority — automated, scalable, and cost-efficient.
Our solutions integrate seamlessly into existing defense and maritime infrastructures, delivering fast data fusion and AI-enhanced analytics for robust situational awareness in dynamic environments. We build platform-agnostic systems that enable real interoperability across domains.
As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll directly impact the technical direction of our orchestration products – Hydris – the coordination engine for sensors and mission systems, and the interoperability API that underpins it.
You'll work at the layer where heterogeneous real-world systems like radars, AIS receivers, LoRa mesh radios, satellite feeds, and C2 platforms become a single coherent picture. The problems lie in distributed systems, protocols, and data modeling areas. They play out in environments that are bandwidth-constrained, intermittently connected, and operationally unforgiving.
The role is deeply hands-on, but it expects you to shape what we build and how we build it, not just deliver what's specified.
What you'll do
Core engine development Design and build the systems that power Hydris. Go is your primary language. You should be comfortable reading Rust and TypeScript across the codebase, even if you're not writing in them day-to-day. Own the architecture of a system that must run reliably on edge hardware, in disconnected mesh networks, and at scale — often all of that simultaneously. Protocol and integration architecture Evolve the schema that defines how every sensor, asset, and mission system talks to Hydris. title: Senior Product Manager - Hardware & Edge AI (d/f/m)
description:
New Challenge About Us
Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a defence technology company with offices in Berlin and Munich, and a trusted partner of the German Armed Forces. Our customers field sensors, drones and C2 systems from many vendors that were never built to work together. We build Hydris, an orchestration layer that integrates the systems they already field, and the ones they'll add next, into one picture operators can act on across defence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Hydris runs at the edge, keeps working when the link drops, and its core is open source under Apache 2.0.
As Senior Product Manager for Mission Devices, you'll own the hardware that puts Hydris in the field.
You'll work end-to-end, from discovery with operators through hardware build cycles to fielded units, and you'll decide what gets built rather than work through someone else's backlog. The bar is concrete: devices that run for months off-grid in contested RF environments.
What you'll do
 Discovery and requirements Spend time with end users in their operating environment to understand their workflows in depth, not just their stated requirements. Validate assumptions about value, usability, feasibility and viability through prototypes, bench tests and field trials before committing to hardware fabrication. Analyze contractual specifications with Program Managers, separating firm constraints from areas where there's room for the best technical solution. Roadmap and delivery Maintain an outcome-focused roadmap aligned to hardware build cycles (EVT/DVT/PVT), firmware releases and OTA update pipelines. Define requirements and field metrics for each device, including detection performance, energy efficiency, mission endurance and SWaP, and make the trade-offs between them. Prioritize investment across the device family, deciding where to extend existing devices and where a new one is needed.
